```{r cars,fig.width=13,fig.height=6.5}
rm(list=ls())
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(patchwork)   # Horizontal combine + merge legends
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")
da <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "exp1b")
da$Nlevel <- as.numeric(da$Nlevel)

# ======================
# Split by N history
# ======================
data1 <- da[da$Nhistory == "Ncont", ]
data2 <- da[da$Nhistory == "Ncess", ]

# ======================
# Shared mappings
# ======================
da$Nregime  <- factor(da$Nhistory, levels = c("Ncont", "Ncess"))
da$Nhistory <- factor(da$Nhistory, levels = c("Ncont", "Ncess"))

color_history <- c("Ncont" = "darkred", "Ncess" = "darkblue")
lines <- c("Ncont" = "solid",   "Ncess" = "solid")

# ======================
# Helper: build a two-line label (rho and p) as plotmath strings
# ======================
make_lab <- function(ct) {
  rho <- round(unname(ct$estimate), 3)
  p   <- ct$p.value
  p_str <- if (p < 0.001) sprintf("%.1e", p) else sprintf("%.3f", p)
  list(
    rho = sprintf("atop(italic(rho)==%.3f)", rho),
    p   = sprintf("atop(italic(p)==\"%s\")", p_str)
  )
}

# ==================================================================
# Plot A: ROS vs Nlevel
# ==================================================================
ct_a_cont <- cor.test(data1$Nlevel, data1$ROS, method = "spearman")
ct_a_cess <- cor.test(data2$Nlevel, data2$ROS, method = "spearman")
lab_a_cont <- make_lab(ct_a_cont)
lab_a_cess <- make_lab(ct_a_cess)

p_a <- ggplot(data = da,
              aes(x = Nlevel, y = ROS, colour = Nhistory)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 8) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = Nhistory, linetype = Nhistory), 
    method = 'lm',
    formula = y ~ poly(x, 1, raw = TRUE),
    level = 0.95, se = TRUE, size = 2, alpha = 0.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = color_history,
    labels = c(expression(N[cont]), expression(N[cess]))
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = lines) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(
    colour   = guide_legend(
      title = expression(N[history]),
      override.aes = list(shape = 16, linetype = 0, size = 6, alpha = 1, fill = NA)
    ),
    # 强制隐藏所有的额外图例
    linetype = "none",
    shape    = "none",
    fill     = "none"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 35, y = 2000, parse = TRUE,
           label = lab_a_cont$rho, size = 8, face = "bold", colour = "darkred") +
  annotate("text", x = 35, y = 1900, parse = TRUE,
           label = lab_a_cont$p,   size = 8, face = "bold", colour = "darkred") +
  annotate("text", x = 35, y = 1400, parse = TRUE,
           label = lab_a_cess$rho, size = 8, face = "bold", colour = "darkblue") +
  annotate("text", x = 35, y = 1300, parse = TRUE,
           label = lab_a_cess$p,   size = 8, face = "bold", colour = "darkblue") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12, family = "sans", colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", size = 1.5, linetype = "solid"),
    legend.key       = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
  ) +
  xlab(expression(bold(N~addition~levels~(g~N~m^-2~yr^-1)))) +
  ylab(expression(bold("Relative abundance of ROS-related genes ("*"\u00d7"*"/Gb)")))

# ==================================================================
# Plot B: ARG vs ROS
# ==================================================================
ct_b_cont <- cor.test(data1$ROS, data1$ARG, method = "spearman")
ct_b_cess <- cor.test(data2$ROS, data2$ARG, method = "spearman")
lab_b_cont <- make_lab(ct_b_cont)
lab_b_cess <- make_lab(ct_b_cess)

p_b <- ggplot(data = da,
              aes(x = ROS, y = ARG, colour = Nhistory)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 8) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = Nhistory, linetype = Nhistory), 
    method = 'lm',
    formula = y ~ poly(x, 1, raw = TRUE),
    level = 0.95, se = TRUE, size = 2, alpha = 0.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = color_history,
    labels = c(expression(N[cont]), expression(N[cess]))
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = lines) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(
    colour   = guide_legend(
      title = expression(N[history]),
      override.aes = list(shape = 16, linetype = 0, size = 6, alpha = 1, fill = NA)
    ),
    # 强制隐藏所有的额外图例
    linetype = "none",
    shape    = "none",
    fill     = "none"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 1300, y = 500, parse = TRUE,
           label = lab_b_cont$rho, size = 8, face = "bold", colour = "darkred") +
  annotate("text", x = 1300, y = 440, parse = TRUE,
           label = lab_b_cont$p,   size = 8, face = "bold", colour = "darkred") +
  annotate("text", x = 1500, y = 100, parse = TRUE,
           label = lab_b_cess$rho, size = 8, face = "bold", colour = "darkblue") +
  annotate("text", x = 1500, y = 40,  parse = TRUE,
           label = lab_b_cess$p,   size = 8, face = "bold", colour = "darkblue") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12, family = "sans", colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.title   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", size = 1.5, linetype = "solid"),
    legend.key       = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
  ) +
  xlab(expression(bold("Relative abundance of ROS-related genes ("*"\u00d7"*"/Gb)"))) +
  ylab("Relative abundance of ARGs (\u00d7/Gb)")

# ==================================================================
# Horizontal combine
# ==================================================================
combined <- (p_a | p_b) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("a", "b"))) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    plot.tag        = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    legend.key       = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
  )

print(combined)
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Ex_Fig3ab.pdf",
       plot = combined, width = 13, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r,fig.width=13,fig.height=6.5}
rm(list = ls())

# ======================
# Load packages
# ======================
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsignif)
library(readxl)
library(patchwork)     # ← 横向合并

setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

# ==================================================================
# Plot C: ROS  ~  treatment (Welch's t-test)
# ==================================================================
df_c <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "exp2a")

df_c$treatment <- factor(df_c$treatment, levels = c("Non-acidified", "Acidified"))
df_c$treatment <- factor(df_c$treatment, labels = c("Control", "Acid added"))

t_result <- t.test(ROS ~ treatment,
                   data        = df_c,
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   var.equal   = FALSE)
p_val <- t_result$p.value
t_val <- t_result$statistic

fmt_p <- ifelse(p_val < 0.0001,
                sprintf("%.2e", p_val),
                sprintf("%.3f", p_val))

# ===== 统计标签：t 与 p 均为 bold + italic；数值也 bold =====
stat_label <- sprintf(
  "bolditalic(t) == bold('%.2f') * ',' ~ bolditalic(p) == bold('%s')",
  t_val, fmt_p
)

group_colors <- c("Control" = "#B07AA1", "Acid added" = "#6BAED6")

y_max   <- max(df_c$ROS, na.rm = TRUE)
y_range <- diff(range(df_c$ROS, na.rm = TRUE))
y_pos   <- y_max + y_range * 0.15

p_c <- ggplot(df_c, aes(x = treatment, y = ROS, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5,
               outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = treatment),
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.15),
              size = 8, alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = group_colors) +
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("Control", "Acid added")),
    y_position  = y_pos,
    annotations = stat_label,
    parse       = TRUE,
    textsize    = 6,
    size        = 1.2,
    tip_length  = 0.02,
    vjust       = -0.6
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.28))) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Relative abundance of ROS-related genes (\u00D7/Gb)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold",
                                angle = 90),
    axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid"),
    plot.margin  = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  )

# ==================================================================
# Plot D: ARG ~ ROS (Spearman)
# ==================================================================
df_d <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "exp2a")

df_d$treatment <- factor(df_d$treatment, levels = c("Non-acidified", "Acidified"))
df_d$treatment <- factor(df_d$treatment, labels = c("Control", "Acid added"))

xvar <- "ROS"
yvar <- "ARG"
xlab_text <- "Relative abundance of ROS-related genes (\u00D7/Gb)"
ylab_text <- "Relative abundance of ARGs (\u00D7/Gb)"

cor_res <- cor.test(df_d[[xvar]], df_d[[yvar]], method = "spearman")
rho_val <- round(unname(cor_res$estimate), 3)
p_raw   <- cor_res$p.value

fmt_p_d <- if (p_raw < 0.001) sprintf("%.1e", p_raw) else sprintf("%.3f", p_raw)

# ===== 统计标签：rho 与 p 均为 bold + italic；数值也 bold =====
cor_label <- sprintf(
  "atop(bolditalic(rho) == bold(%.3f), bolditalic(p) == bold('%s'))",
  rho_val, fmt_p_d
)

x_min <- min(df_d[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE); x_max <- max(df_d[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
y_min <- min(df_d[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE); y_max <- max(df_d[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)

anno_x <- x_min + 0.05 * (x_max - x_min)
anno_y <- y_max - 0.15 * (y_max - y_min)

p_d <- ggplot(df_d, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]],
                        colour = treatment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 8) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = 'lm',
    formula = y ~ poly(x, 1, raw = TRUE),
    level = 0.95, se = TRUE, size = 2, alpha = 0.5,
    color = "black", fill = "grey70"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_colors,
                      labels = c("Control", "Acid added")) +
  annotate("text", x = anno_x, y = anno_y,
           label = cor_label, parse = TRUE,
           size = 8, colour = "black", hjust = 0) +
  labs(x = xlab_text, y = ylab_text, colour = "Treatment") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12, family = "sans", colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                size = 1.5, linetype = "solid"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

# ==================================================================
# 横向合并：左 c，右 d
# ==================================================================
combined <- (p_c | p_d) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("c", "d"))) &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold")
  )

print(combined)

ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Ex_Fig3cd.pdf",
       combined, width = 13, height = 6.5, dpi = 600)
```

```{r,fig.width=13,fig.height=6.5}
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")
rm(list = ls())

library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(agricolae)
library(car)
library(rstatix)
library(dunn.test)
library(patchwork)

# ==================================================================
# Plot E: ROS ~ treatment2 (two-way ANOVA + CLD)
# ==================================================================
da_e <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "exp2b")
da_e$treatment2 <- factor(da_e$treatment2,
                          levels = c("N0-L0", "N20-L0", "N0-L45", "N20-L45"))

da_e$N <- factor(sub("-.*", "", as.character(da_e$treatment2)), levels = c("N0", "N20"))
da_e$L <- factor(sub(".*-", "", as.character(da_e$treatment2)), levels = c("L0", "L45"))

yvar      <- "ROS"
ylab_ros  <- "Relative abundance of ROS-related genes (\u00D7/Gb)"

col11 <- c("#1A1C60","#E27D7C", "#B983DF","#8B5A2B")

trt_labs <- c(
  "N0-L0"   = "Control",
  "N20-L0"  = "N",
  "N0-L45"  = "L",
  "N20-L45" = "N+L"
)

# ===== 双因素 ANOVA 文本：两行显示，N/L 在上，N×L 在下 =====
anova_lab <- function(y, N, L) {
  fit <- aov(y ~ N * L)
  s   <- summary(fit)[[1]]
  fmt <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA",
                            ifelse(x < 0.001,
                                   format(x, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3),
                                   sprintf("%.3f", x)))
  f1 <- fmt(s[1, "F value"]); p1 <- fmt(s[1, "Pr(>F)"])
  f2 <- fmt(s[2, "F value"]); p2 <- fmt(s[2, "Pr(>F)"])
  f3 <- fmt(s[3, "F value"]); p3 <- fmt(s[3, "Pr(>F)"])
  
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      "atop(",
      "bold(N)*':'~bolditalic(F)==bold(\"%s\")*','~bolditalic(p)==bold(\"%s\")*'   '*",
      "bold(L)*':'~bolditalic(F)==bold(\"%s\")*','~bolditalic(p)==bold(\"%s\"), ",
      "bold(N*'\u00D7'*L)*':'~bolditalic(F)==bold(\"%s\")*','~bolditalic(p)==bold(\"%s\")",
      ")"
    ),
    f1, p1, f2, p2, f3, p3
  )
}

shapiro_res <- da_e %>%
  group_by(treatment2) %>%
  summarise(W = shapiro.test(.data[[yvar]])$statistic,
            p = shapiro.test(.data[[yvar]])$p.value,
            .groups = "drop")
lev <- leveneTest(as.formula(paste(yvar, "~ treatment2")), data = da_e)
normal_ok <- all(shapiro_res$p > 0.05)
var_ok    <- lev$`Pr(>F)`[1] > 0.05

if (normal_ok && var_ok) {
  method <- "Tukey HSD"
} else if (normal_ok && !var_ok) {
  method <- "Games-Howell"
} else {
  method <- "Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn"
}

cld_from_pairs <- function(groups, pairs, p_col = "p.adj", alpha = 0.05) {
  groups <- as.character(groups)
  n <- length(groups)
  diff_mat <- matrix(FALSE, n, n, dimnames = list(groups, groups))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairs))) {
    g1 <- as.character(pairs[[1]][i]); g2 <- as.character(pairs[[2]][i])
    p  <- pairs[[p_col]][i]
    if (!is.na(p) && p < alpha) {
      diff_mat[g1, g2] <- TRUE; diff_mat[g2, g1] <- TRUE
    }
  }
  letters_pool <- letters
  assign <- rep(NA_character_, n); names(assign) <- groups
  current_letter <- 1; remaining <- groups
  while (length(remaining) > 0) {
    grp_set <- remaining[1]
    for (g in remaining[-1]) {
      ok <- TRUE
      for (h in grp_set) if (diff_mat[g, h]) { ok <- FALSE; break }
      if (ok) grp_set <- c(grp_set, g)
    }
    for (g in grp_set) {
      assign[g] <- ifelse(is.na(assign[g]), letters_pool[current_letter],
                          paste0(assign[g], letters_pool[current_letter]))
    }
    remaining <- setdiff(remaining, grp_set)
    current_letter <- current_letter + 1
  }
  data.frame(grp = groups, sig_lab = assign, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

df2 <- data.frame(y = da_e[[yvar]], trt = da_e$treatment2)
if (method == "Tukey HSD") {
  fit <- aov(y ~ trt, data = df2)
  hsd <- agricolae::HSD.test(fit, "trt", group = TRUE)
  g   <- hsd$groups
  lab <- data.frame(grp = rownames(g), sig_lab = as.character(g$groups),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else if (method == "Games-Howell") {
  gh  <- rstatix::games_howell_test(df2, y ~ trt)
  lab <- cld_from_pairs(unique(df2$trt), gh, p_col = "p.adj")
} else {
  dt  <- rstatix::dunn_test(df2, y ~ trt, p.adjust.method = "BH")
  lab <- cld_from_pairs(unique(df2$trt), dt, p_col = "p.adj")
}

ymin <- min(da_e[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
ymax <- max(da_e[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
yran <- ymax - ymin

mx <- da_e %>%
  group_by(treatment2) %>%
  summarise(max_y = max(.data[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE) + 0.08 * yran,
            .groups = "drop")
lab <- left_join(lab, mx, by = c("grp" = "treatment2"))

anova_txt <- anova_lab(da_e[[yvar]], da_e$N, da_e$L)

p_e <- ggplot(da_e, aes(x = treatment2, y = .data[[yvar]])) +
  geom_jitter(aes(fill = treatment2, color = treatment2),
              shape = 21, stroke = 0.4,
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15,
                                              dodge.width  = 0.5),
              size = 8, alpha = 0.8) +     # <--- 修改：点透明度改为 0.8
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = treatment2),
               width = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.4, # <--- 修改：箱线图透明度微调至 0.5
               position = position_dodge(0.5), outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = trt_labs) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col11, labels = trt_labs) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col11, labels = trt_labs) +
  geom_text(data = lab, aes(x = grp, y = max_y, label = sig_lab),
            size = 6, fontface = "bold", colour = "black",
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(subtitle = parse(text = anova_txt),
       fill = "Treatment", color = "Treatment",
       x = "", y = ylab_ros) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold",
                                 colour = "black", lineheight = 1.1,
                                 margin = margin(t = 0, b = 6)),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.line    = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks   = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid"),
    plot.margin  = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(ymin - 0.05 * yran, ymax + 0.30 * yran),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  )

# ==================================================================
# Plot F: ARG5_CARD ~ ROS (Spearman)
# ==================================================================
da_f <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "exp2b")
da_f$treatment2 <- factor(da_f$treatment2,
                          levels = c("N0-L0", "N20-L0", "N0-L45", "N20-L45"))

xvar    <- "ROS"
yvar_f  <- "ARG5_CARD"
xlab_text <- "Relative abundance of ROS-related genes (\u00D7/Gb)"
ylab_text <- "Relative abundance of ARGs (\u00D7/Gb)"

cor_res <- cor.test(da_f[[xvar]], da_f[[yvar_f]],
                    method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
rho_val <- round(cor_res$estimate, 3)
p_val   <- format(cor_res$p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)

cor_label <- paste0("atop(bolditalic(rho) == bold(\"", rho_val,
                    "\"), bolditalic(p) == bold(\"", p_val, "\"))")

x_min <- min(da_f[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE); x_max <- max(da_f[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
y_min <- min(da_f[[yvar_f]], na.rm = TRUE); y_max <- max(da_f[[yvar_f]], na.rm = TRUE)

anno_x <- x_min + 0.05 * (x_max - x_min)
anno_y <- y_max - 0.15 * (y_max - y_min)

p_f <- ggplot(data = da_f, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar_f]],
                               colour = treatment2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 8) +        # <--- 修改：点透明度改为 0.8
  geom_smooth(
    method  = 'lm',
    formula = y ~ poly(x, 1, raw = TRUE),
    level   = 0.95, se = TRUE, size = 2, alpha = 0.3, # <--- 修改：拟合线阴影透明度微调至 0.3
    color   = "black", fill = "grey70"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col11, labels = trt_labs) +
  annotate("text", x = anno_x, y = anno_y,
           label = cor_label, parse = TRUE,
           size = 6, colour = "black", hjust = 0) +
  labs(x = xlab_text, y = ylab_text, colour = "Treatment") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12, family = "sans", colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                size = 1.5, linetype = "solid"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

# ==================================================================
# 横向合并：左 e，右 f
# ==================================================================
combined <- (p_e | p_f) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("e", "f"))) &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold")
  )

print(combined)

ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Ex_Fig3ef.pdf",
       combined, width = 13, height = 6.5, dpi = 600)
```

```{r,fig.width=13,fig.height=6.5}
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(agricolae)
library(car)
library(patchwork)

# ==================================================================
# Plot G: ROS ~ treatment2 (two-way ANOVA + Tukey HSD)
# ==================================================================
da_g <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "exp2c")
da_g$treatment2 <- factor(da_g$treatment2,
                          levels = c("N0-C0", "N50-C0", "N0-C2000", "N50-C2000"))

da_g$N <- factor(sub("-.*", "", as.character(da_g$treatment2)), levels = c("N0", "N50"))
da_g$C <- factor(sub(".*-", "", as.character(da_g$treatment2)), levels = c("C0", "C2000"))

yvar      <- "ROS"
ylab_ros  <- "Relative abundance of ROS-related genes (\u00D7/Gb)"

col11 <- c("#7D7D7D", "#CC4125", "#F5C87A", "#8FD3F4")

trt_labs <- c(
  "N0-C0"     = "Control",
  "N50-C0"    = "N",
  "N0-C2000"  = "C",
  "N50-C2000" = "N+C"
)

# ===== 双因素 ANOVA 文本：两行，N/C 在上，N×C 在下 =====
anova_lab <- function(y, N, C) {
  df_tmp <- data.frame(y = y, N = N, C = C)
  fit <- aov(y ~ N * C, data = df_tmp)
  anova3 <- Anova(fit, type = "III")
  s   <- as.data.frame(anova3)
  
  fmt <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA",
                            ifelse(x < 0.001,
                                   format(x, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3),
                                   sprintf("%.3f", x)))
  f1 <- fmt(s["N", "F value"]); p1 <- fmt(s["N", "Pr(>F)"])
  f2 <- fmt(s["C", "F value"]); p2 <- fmt(s["C", "Pr(>F)"])
  f3 <- fmt(s["N:C", "F value"]); p3 <- fmt(s["N:C", "Pr(>F)"])
  
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      "atop(",
      "bold(N)*':'~bolditalic(F)==bold(\"%s\")*','~bolditalic(p)==bold(\"%s\")*'   '*",
      "bold(C)*':'~bolditalic(F)==bold(\"%s\")*','~bolditalic(p)==bold(\"%s\"), ",
      "bold(N*'\u00D7'*C)*':'~bolditalic(F)==bold(\"%s\")*','~bolditalic(p)==bold(\"%s\")",
      ")"
    ),
    f1, p1, f2, p2, f3, p3
  )
}

df2 <- data.frame(y = da_g[[yvar]], trt = da_g$treatment2)
fit_trt <- aov(y ~ trt, data = df2)
hsd <- agricolae::HSD.test(fit_trt, "trt", group = TRUE, console = FALSE)
lab <- data.frame(
  grp = rownames(hsd$groups),
  sig_lab = as.character(hsd$groups$groups),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

ymin <- min(da_g[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
ymax <- max(da_g[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
yran <- ymax - ymin

mx <- da_g %>%
  group_by(treatment2) %>%
  summarise(max_y = max(.data[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE) + 0.08 * yran,
            .groups = "drop")

lab <- left_join(lab, mx, by = c("grp" = "treatment2"))

anova_txt <- anova_lab(da_g[[yvar]], da_g$N, da_g$C)

p_g <- ggplot(da_g, aes(x = treatment2, y = .data[[yvar]])) +
  geom_jitter(aes(fill = treatment2, color = treatment2),
              position = position_dodge(0.5),
              size = 8, alpha = 0.8) +   # 保持 0.8 不变
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = treatment2),
               width = 0.5, alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4,
               position = position_dodge(0.5), outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = trt_labs) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col11, labels = trt_labs) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col11, labels = trt_labs) +
  geom_text(data = lab, aes(x = grp, y = max_y, label = sig_lab),
            size = 6, fontface = "bold", colour = "black",
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(
    subtitle = parse(text = anova_txt),
    fill     = "Treatment",
    color    = "Treatment",
    x        = "",
    y        = ylab_ros
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16,
                                 face = "bold", colour = "black",
                                 lineheight = 1.1,
                                 margin = margin(t = 0, b = 6)),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.line    = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks   = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid"),
    plot.margin  = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(ymin - 0.05 * yran, ymax + 0.30 * yran),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  )
```
